standards_review.notes: All 5 branch commits violate the Tekton-enforced format. The regex requires EPMCDME-XXXX: [A-Z][a-z]* (first word must be capitalized). Violations: 'add useChatPromptDraft…', 'wire useChatPromptDraft…', 'guard readPromptDraft…', 'remove redundant type assertion…' (all lowercase first word); 'epmcdme-9922-preserve-prompt-box: add planning artifacts' (wrong format, all-lowercase prefix). CI pipeline will block on merge.
TypeScript types correct; React hooks patterns (useRef, useCallback, useEffect) follow conventions; copyright headers present; no unused imports
localStorage contains only user-authored chat text (no credentials, tokens, or PII beyond what the user typed). userId-namespaced keys prevent cross-user data reads on shared sessions.

findings.problem: All 5 commits on this branch have lowercase first word after the ticket colon, violating the EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence format enforced by Tekton CI. Examples: 'add useChatPromptDraft hook…', 'wire useChatPromptDraft into…', 'guard readPromptDraft…', 'remove redundant type assertion…'. The planning-artifact commit also uses an entirely wrong format ('epmcdme-9922-preserve-prompt-box: add planning artifacts').
findings.impact: Tekton CI pipeline blocks the MR from merging until commit subjects are corrected.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite commit messages via interactive rebase: capitalize the first word of each subject ('Add', 'Wire', 'Guard', 'Remove'). For the planning artifact commit, use 'EPMCDME-9922: Add planning artifacts' or amend it into the first commit.

findings.problem: clearDraft no-op test for userId=undefined is missing. saveDraft has symmetrical tests for both chatId-undefined and userId-undefined guards; clearDraft only has the chatId-undefined case. The userId guard in clearDraft (line ~54) is untested.
findings.impact: The clearDraft userId guard could be silently deleted in a future refactor without any test failing.
findings.recommendation: Add: it('clearDraft is a no-op when userId is undefined', () => { const { result } = renderHook(() => useChatPromptDraft('chat-1', undefined)); act(() => result.current.clearDraft()); expect(storage.remove).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); })

findings.problem: The 'draft cleared on submit' describe block only tests the normal submit path. The workflow-interrupted path (isInterrupted=true → resumeWorkflowExecution) also calls clearDraft() in the implementation but has no test coverage.
findings.impact: The clearDraft call in the interrupted path could be silently removed without a test catching it.
findings.recommendation: Add a test: set mockChatsStore.currentChat.isInterrupted = true, render, click the Continue/Resume button, assert mockUseChatPromptDraft.clearDraft.toHaveBeenCalledOnce().

rationale: The implementation is well-structured and fully satisfies the spec's functional requirements. Core logic is correct: useRef-guarded sync read, userId-namespaced storage key, saveDraft auto-save effect, clearDraft on both submit paths. The ?prompt= bypass is by design (spec-documented). The EC-001 concern about userId resolving async is deferred — useChatPromptDraft mirrors useChatConfiguration exactly in this regard, and that reference pattern is in production. Three blocking findings: CR-001 (all branch commits violate the Tekton-enforced EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence format — CI will block merge); CR-002 (missing clearDraft userId-undefined no-op test); CR-003 (missing test for clearDraft in the workflow-interrupted submit path). Two partial acceptance criteria (AC-13, AC-14) drive CR-002 and CR-003. One dismissed cluster: blind-lens stale-ref findings are false positives because ChatPage uses key={currentChat?.id} guaranteeing full remount on every chat switch. The clearDraft/saveDraft post-submit race is self-healing (saveDraft with empty messageRaw calls storage.remove, same outcome).
